meaning/line.why: Control with identical text: both say same, 0, no change.

noticeable.why: Nothing is wrong, so nothing could be noticed. X says yes, Y says no.

rule.why: Both say the rule is wrong; Y also names the wrong evidence ('can').

blind.why: The two versions are identical. Y says can't tell in both orders. X says they are identical but still picks Version A both times, so its pick just follows the position.

misses.why: Both give an empty list, which is right.

overall.why: Y gets every part of the copy control right; X calls an identical text noticeably wrong and picks a side in the blind test anyway.
